newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL JULY TAX RECEIPTS RISE TO 9.743 BLN REAIS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL JULY TAX RECEIPTS RISE TO 9.743 BLN REAIS.

text.p: Brazil's federal tax receipts rose 17.53 percent in real terms in July to 9.743 billion reais compared with 8.302 billion reais in the same month a year ago, the Internal Revenue service said Wednesday.
In nominal terms, which does not take into account inflation, July's tax receipts were 25.01 percent higher than in July 1996.

The Internal Revenue Service said in a statement that the July result brought federal tax revenue for the year so far to 62.482 billion reais, a 7.73 percent increase in real terms over the January-July period last year. In nominal terms, the increase was 16.96 percent over tax receipts of 53.422 billion reais in the first seven months of 1996.
